content.user_title: Explore a Chrome Font Inspector Guide
content.value_statement: Planning a font inspection extension requires understanding typography features and Chrome loading steps. This public guide outlines the original package without supplying its source.
actual_capabilities: Describe the documented font inspector overlay and typography properties.
Summarize the original package's CSS, shorthand CSS, and Tailwind export options.
Explain the documented use of a local paid-to-free font mapping database.
Provide manual steps for loading an existing unpacked extension in Chrome.
Outline the documented vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS approach.
limitations: Only the public guide is included; scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
The described font mapping database is not supplied, so matches cannot be verified.
The guide cannot inspect live webpages or export their styles by itself.
Runtime behavior, permissions, and production readiness cannot be verified without the extension source.

use_cases.title: Evaluate typography inspection features
use_cases.description: Review the documented font properties and export formats before selecting a font inspection workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan an extension implementation
use_cases.description: Use the documented Manifest V3 structure and vanilla stack as planning context, while identifying missing implementation files.

use_cases.title: Review onboarding requirements
use_cases.description: Summarize unpacked loading steps and explain which original package assets must be obtained separately.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the public guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this font inspector guide. Separate documented features from files actually included.

prompt_templates.title: Explain unpacked loading
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the guide's Chrome unpacked loading steps. State what source directory I must obtain before those steps can work.

prompt_templates.title: Compare typography exports
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the documented CSS, shorthand CSS, and Tailwind export options. Identify details that cannot be verified without source.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a source review
prompt_templates.prompt: Using only this guide, create a review checklist for separately obtained extension source. Cover permissions, content scripts, background workers, and font mappings.

output_examples.input: Does this skill include a working extension?
output_examples.output: No. This folder contains only the public guide. The extension source, scripts, and templates must be obtained separately.

output_examples.input: What typography features does the guide describe?
output: An overlay showing font family, size, weight, and line height.
Exports described as standard CSS, shorthand CSS, and Tailwind classes.
Local mappings from paid fonts to free Google Font alternatives.
These features are documented claims, not executable features in this folder.

output_examples.input: How would I load the extension after obtaining its source?
output_examples.output: Open Chrome's Extensions page, enable Developer mode, and choose Load unpacked. Select the reviewed extension directory containing its manifest.

best_practices: Confirm that extension source is available before attempting installation.
Review separately obtained source and requested permissions before loading an unpacked extension.
Treat font mappings and production readiness as unverified until tested against the actual implementation.
anti_patterns: Treating this documentation-only folder as a ready-to-load Chrome extension.
Assuming the original package's mapping database is included or complete.
Claiming website inspection or CSS export succeeded without an installed and tested implementation.

faq.question: What is included in this skill folder?
faq.answer: Only the public SKILL.md guide is included. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not present.

faq.question: Can I inspect webpage fonts immediately?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes that capability, but a working extension implementation must be obtained and installed separately.

faq.question: Which technology stack does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes a Manifest V3 extension using vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS without a build framework.

faq.question: Are the Google Font mappings included?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes more than 70 mappings in the original package, but the database is absent from this folder.

faq.question: Which export formats are described?
faq.answer: The guide names standard CSS, shorthand CSS, and Tailwind utility classes. Their implementation cannot be verified from the supplied file.

faq.question: Does this audit establish that the extension is safe?
faq.answer: No. The audit covers only the supplied guide. Separately obtained extension code requires its own permission and runtime review.
